target.title: fix: prevent stale PR review labels from persisting
target.body:
## Summary

- Detect open PR reports where the stored `pull_head_sha` no longer matches the live PR head.
- Stop syncing old PR review-derived labels in that state, and remove stale rating/status/merge-risk/proof/showcase labels while preserving generic triage labels.
- Replace the durable review comment with a stale-review notice that records the reviewed and current head SHAs instead of republishing the old verdict.

## Problem

Refs openclaw/openclaw#99335. That PR had a durable ClawSweeper review for an older head while the PR branch had moved, but the apply path could still leave review-derived labels from the old verdict on the live PR.

## Why this layer

`apply-decisions` is the path that mutates GitHub labels and durable comments from stored reports. Guarding stale heads there prevents old review state from being published or retained while the fresh review catches up.

## Validation

- `PATH=/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:$PATH node --test test/apply-label-sync.test.ts`
- `PATH=/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:$PATH pnpm run check`
- `git diff --check`

## Staged Apply Proof

This is a staged apply run using the real `apply-decisions` path with a mock `gh` shim, so no live GitHub labels or comments were mutated. The scenario models a durable report reviewed at `reviewed-old-head` while the live PR head has moved to `live-new-head`.

Command:

```bash
PATH=/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:/Users/mauriceniu/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/bin:$PATH node --input-type=module <staged stale-head apply proof>
```

Output:

```text
[apply] starting apply: files=1 dry_run=false apply_kind=issue sync_comments_only=true item_numbers=99335
[apply] finished apply closed=0/10 processed=1/1 counts={"review_comment_synced":1}
staged apply proof: PASS
reviewed head: reviewed-old-head
live head: live-new-head
removed review-derived labels: merge-risk: 🚨 session-state, proof: sufficient, rating: 🧂 unranked krab, status: 🔁 re-review loop
preserved labels after apply: ["P2"]
updated report current_pull_head_sha: live-new-head
stale comment status: Codex review: stale review; fresh review needed.
stale comment marker: <!-- clawsweeper-review-status:stale item=99335 reviewed_sha=reviewed-old-head current_sha=live-new-head reason=stale_head -->
old verdict marker present after patch: false
```

The staged run confirms the stale-head path removes only review-derived PR labels, preserves the generic `P2` label, records the current live head, replaces the durable comment with the stale-review notice, and does not keep publishing the old `clawsweeper-verdict` marker.
